Episodes.Title: BTW inbegrepen
Episodes.Actors: Danni Heylen, An Swartenbroekx, Herman Verbruggen
Episodes.Plot: DDT gets charged with fraud. Boma and Bieke are both interested in the building. Meanwhile Xavier gets an unexpected visit of his cousin Bernard.

Episodes.Title: De splinternieuwe trainer
Episodes.Actors: Danni Heylen, An Swartenbroekx, Herman Verbruggen
Episodes.Plot: Pol gets injured. He is forced to end his football career. Pol replaces Xavier as coach of the team. Carmen doesn't agree with this and is temporarily in league with Bernard to get under the skin of De Kampioenen.

Episodes.Title: Bertha Boma
Episodes.Actors: Danni Heylen, An Swartenbroekx, Herman Verbruggen
Episodes.Plot: Boma gets a visit from his sister Bertha. When Bernard meets Bertha, Bernard believes he met the woman of his dreams.

Episodes.Title: Interim Sponsor
Episodes.Actors: Danni Heylen, An Swartenbroekx, Herman Verbruggen
Episodes.Plot: Boma is no longer needed as team sponsor after he had accepted on a proposal to bribery. Bernard becomes the new sponsor. Boma takes it to heart that he isn't part of De Kampioenen anymore.

Episodes.Title: Boma failliet
Episodes.Actors: Danni Heylen, An Swartenbroekx, Herman Verbruggen
Episodes.Plot: Carmen hears a conversation between Boma and Xavier's colonel Vandesijpe and thinks Bomaworst enterprise, Boma Vleesindustrie N.V., went bankrupt after an unflattering article, written in the newspaper by Bieke.
